evidence_classes.parent_independent_direct_function_oracl: separately written closed-form expected value from Phase 0.24
evidence_classes.independent_source_rederived_closed_form: new Phase 0.25 expected value re-derived from the normative formula without calling a production helper
evidence_classes.external_vendor_published_cross_implemen: comparison against a numerical value published in an external vendor verification example; not a live vendor run
evidence_classes.contract_adversarial_probe: negative test proving malformed/non-finite comparator evidence is rejected

anti_overclaim_rules: Regression/self-check agreement is not independent validation.
A closed-form oracle validates the target function at the tested point, not every branch or applicability route.
A vendor-published comparator value is external cross-implementation evidence, not a live vendor execution.
A downstream formula supplied with a published coefficient does not validate generation of that coefficient.
